name: VideoHelperSuite
notes: Already in NODE_PACKS at this commit; add VHS_VideoCombine to its classes. Only birefnet_video_matte_alpha uses it: core SaveVideo writes rgb24 frames only, so it cannot keep an alpha channel. VHS pipes rgba frames to ffmpeg (system ffmpeg, else the imageio-ffmpeg binary) and writes WebM VP9 with pix_fmt yuva420p. Its UI output key is 'gifs', not 'images' or 'videos'.
